title: The Ghost of Vienna Again
author: Hazel Nystrom
blurb: Lena Hartwell, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
